definitions.explanation: a moderate flame or heat setting used in cooking, between low and high heat

examples.japanese: {中火|ちゅうび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧。
{中火|ちゅうび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{五分|ごふん}→五分：09573_gofun⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
examples.english: Grill on medium heat for 5 minutes.

examples.japanese: ⟦フライパン→フライパン：01025_furaipan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{中火|ちゅうび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{温|あたた}める→温める：02096_atatameru⟧。
examples.english: Heat the frying pan on medium heat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強火|つよび}→強火：08170_tsuyobi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{中火|ちゅうび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧。
examples.english: Reduce from high to medium heat.

examples.japanese: {中火|ちゅうび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦じっくり→じっくり：06252_jikkuri⟧⟦{両面|りょうめん}→両面：11366_ryoumen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
examples.english: Grill both sides thoroughly on medium heat.

notes:
{中火|ちゅうび} is the standard medium heat setting used in Japanese cooking. It is the most commonly called-for heat level in recipes.

COMPOUND: ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (middle) + {火|び} (fire/heat)

HEAT LEVELS IN COOKING:
- ⟦{弱火|よわび}→弱火：08168_yowabi⟧: low heat (simmering, delicate dishes)
- {中火|ちゅうび}: medium heat (general cooking)
- ⟦{強火|つよび}→強火：08170_tsuyobi⟧: high heat (searing, stir-fry)
- ⟦とろ{火|び}→とろ火：08577_torobi⟧: very low heat (slow cooking)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {中火|ちゅうび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set to medium heat
- {中火|ちゅうび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to grill on medium heat
- {中火|ちゅうび}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧: to simmer on medium heat
- {中火|ちゅうび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to reduce to medium heat
